items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: which were Louis Hunt and Louis Bacon, and he put the three of them together and he had a wonderful trumpet section.

ctx.x: Well, I don't know. Not really. We were playing -- well, I always -- getting back to Chick, he picked the men for this band, like I said, he made the band up from scratch. He didn't -- and I always remember the trumpet players he had. He had Shelton Hemphill, who came to New York with Horace Henderson's band, and of course you know Horace

was -- sometimes he was doing -- working, and sometimes he wasn't. So Chick went to Shelton Hemphill, we used to call him ScaK, ScaK Hemphill, and he got him to play one trumpet. Then he went down to a dancing school, Melody Gardens or something like that, and hired the two trumpet players who were in the dancing school, which were Louis Hunt and Louis Bacon, and he put the three of them together and he had a wonderful trumpet section. Yeah. That's the way he put them together like that, and it worked…
